zh.text: 斯坦福大学是一所位于美国加利福尼亚州斯坦福的私立研究型大学。学校由利兰·斯坦福夫妇于1885年创立，以纪念其早逝的儿子，并于1891年正式招收首批学生。该校在建立之初即实行男女兼收及宗教自由政策。校园坐落于硅谷附近，由七所学院组成，并设有胡佛研究所。二战后，学校鼓励创业精神，对当地科技产业的发展产生了深远影响。

en.text: Stanford University is a private research university located in Stanford, California. It was founded in 1885 by Leland and Jane Stanford in memory of their son, admitting its first students in 1891. The institution opened as coeducational and non-denominational. The campus is situated near Silicon Valley and is organized around seven schools of study. It houses the Hoover Institution, a public policy think tank. Following World War II, the university fostered an entrepreneurial culture that contributed to the development of the local tech industry.
